name: 5-MeO-T-NBOMe
summary: 5-MeO-T-NBOMe, also known as 5MT-NBOMe or NBOMe-5-MeO-T, is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family related to the 25-NB (NBOMe) drugs. It has been sold online as a designer drug.

pharmacology.text: 5-MeO-T-NBOMe is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist and produces the head-twitch response in rodents. However, compared to 25I-NBOMe, the drug is much less potent in producing the head-twitch response (~10-fold) and produces a much weaker maximal response (~25%).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: It has been sold online as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic tryptamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: The NBOMe trick, adding a 2-methoxybenzyl group to a nitrogen, made phenethylamine psychedelics such as 25I-NBOMe hugely more potent. Applied to a tryptamine here, it works far less well.
fact.zh: 所謂的NBOMe手法，就是在氮上加一個2-甲氧基苄基，這讓25I-NBOMe等苯乙胺類迷幻藥的效力大幅提升。但把同樣手法用在這個色胺上，效果就差得多。
fact.zhHans: 所谓的NBOMe手法，就是在氮上加一个2-甲氧基苄基，这让25I-NBOMe等苯乙胺类迷幻药的效力大幅提升。但把同样手法用在这个色胺上，效果就差得多。
